mapper.insert: INSERT INTO ai_conversation_message (session_id, user_id, role, message, create_time, update_time, deleted) VALUES (#{sessionId}, #{userId}, #{role}, #{message}, #{createTime}, #{updateTime}, #{deleted})
mapper.select: SELECT id, session_id, user_id, role, message, create_time, update_time FROM ai_conversation_message WHERE session_id = #{sessionId} AND deleted = 0 ORDER BY create_time ASC
mapper.update: UPDATE ai_conversation_message SET deleted = 1 WHERE session_id = #{sessionId} AND deleted = 0
